scope: Non-nursery recommended JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS and JSON rules, explicit React/Next domains, and auto-detected Tailwind/Turborepo domains. No Test dependency was declared. Other languages are not used by this repository.
caveat: Mappings identify coverage, not identical diagnostics or fix semantics. Source-same/source-inspired reflect Biome metadata. Related mappings were reviewed against Bun descriptions. Partial and unavailable rows remain parity gaps. Bun defaults and stricter project assertions also remain enabled.
